title: A Locker for the Playlist
author: Emrys Almeida
blurb: Mara Oyelaran, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
